_note: Finale 1: Mirela at the edge of the Undrawn (plan items 1525, 1526). The chain finale_1 to finale_5 runs on entering undrawn_3; a lost battle stops it and it starts again from here.

say: At the very end of the drawn land, an old woman sits on a folding stool, drawing.
A Wickit sleeps on her shoulder. Its flame is the colour of old paper.
Mirela: Oh. Oh, look at you. You have Aldo's chin. And my terrible handwriting, I bet.
Mirela: Forty years I've drawn this edge. If I stop, the Wide Rift tears open. So I don't stop.
Mirela: People ask if I get lonely. I tell them the Echo talks back. Then they stop asking. Works every time.
